name: Avance Technologies Limited
summary: Avance Technologies Ltd. is dedicated to supplying mobile data services. The company's diverse range of solutions includes short code functionalities, strategic mobile marketing for businesses, comprehensive mobile marketing suites, integration services for electronic mail and the web, ad placement programs, Wireless Application Protocol (WAP) capabilities, and a call conferencing system. Founded on January 30, 1985, this firm operates from its headquarters in Mumbai, India.
